# Abu Dhabi Properties

> An independent guide to established real estate developers active in Abu Dhabi — their backgrounds, areas of activity and official websites.

Abu Dhabi Properties is an independent editorial directory. It is not a real estate agency or broker, does not sell property and is not affiliated with the companies it profiles.

## Developer profiles
- [Aldar Properties](https://www.abudhabi-properties.com/developers/aldar/): An ADX-listed Abu Dhabi property group developing and managing master-planned communities across Yas Island, Saadiyat Island, Al Raha and Reem Island.
- [Modon](https://www.abudhabi-properties.com/developers/modon/): An Abu Dhabi-based, ADX-listed holding company whose real estate arm is master-developing Hudayriyat Island alongside projects on Reem Island.
- [Bloom Holding](https://www.abudhabi-properties.com/developers/bloom/): An Abu Dhabi developer and services group, part of National Holding, best known for the Bloom Living community in Zayed City and the Bloom Gardens neighbourhood.
- [Reportage Group](https://www.abudhabi-properties.com/developers/reportage/): An Abu Dhabi-headquartered developer founded in 2014, building apartment and community projects on Reem, Yas and Saadiyat islands and in Masdar City, with a growing international footprint.
